Steps: (1) Open the Links editor at http://localhost:4321/dashboard/cards/creative/links. (2) If authenticated find an existing group block which is collapsible and expand it. (3) Inspect the group controls: confirm a Direction control with Horizontal and Vertical options and an Alignment control exist inside the expanded group only - not on ungrouped links. (4) Switch Direction from Vertical to Horizontal. (5) Switch Alignment from Start to Space between or the closest available equivalent. (6) Observe the iPhone phone preview pane on the right: confirm the link arrangement visibly updates to reflect horizontal direction and the new alignment - describe before and after arrangement. (7) Open the Add to Group or add-link menu inside the group and confirm there is NO nested Group option - no recursive group inside a group. (8) If a save action is available and the session is authenticated save the card reload the page and confirm the groupType direction and alignment are preserved. (9) Open the public page http://localhost:4321/creative in a new tab and confirm the public layout matches the saved editor layout for direction and alignment. (10) Check the browser console for any errors or warnings and report them verbatim. Report exact observed values for direction and alignment at each step the preview arrangement description whether Add to Group excludes Group save reload result public parity result and any console errors.
